comment: Independent cheap variation of mounted wounded-legs healing: a one-turn timed wound expires while mounted before voluntary dismount. The ordinary timeout site heals the steed silently; dismount then has no remaining wound to repair. Same map seed fixes the mounted route while changing the wound duration changes the source branch.
